name: Default
shortDescription: Double Commander two-panel file manager streamed to the browser behind a password, with settings and files in the home directory kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container. Keep files under /config so they persist.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
